verdict.rationale: Bun's package manager is a standalone local CLI that runs entirely on the user's own machine in any Node.js project. It keeps a local global cache and offers a mode that never touches the network, so the core product is inherently self-run with no hosted service required. Missing for 10: evidence of an open-source license or buildable source, documentation for pointing installs at a self-hosted or private registry, and independent hands-on corroboration of fully offline or self-hosted operation.
